title: fix(metadata)!: MetadataManager.loadMany takes a by-package name's bodies and packages off the loader's keyed entries; loadManyKeyed entries carry their package
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DDZYUbJbnXUTqZoZ56k4czR)_
Fixes #32680

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill teaches how `MetadataManager`'s plural reads stamp a loader's bodies or what `loadManyKeyed` entries carry; the moved answers live in the metadata service's internal read path.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`MetadataManager.loadMany` 对按包存放的类型，直接用加载器 keyed 条目里每行自己的 body 和包戳，不再按内容把 `loadMany` 的 body 配回行；`loadManyKeyed` 返回的条目带上 `packageId`。
- 为什么改：两个包同名、另有一行 body 也写着这个名字时，旧的内容配对放弃打戳，启动预载把一个 body 放进裸槽，启动后裸读答出这个 body 而不是 409；加载器两次读序列化不同也会无声不打戳；调用方拿到两个同名条目分不清是哪个包。
- 风险与回滚：只影响接了 `DatabaseLoader` 的宿主（工作区内 0 处）；该形状下启动后裸读由答一个 body 改为 409 点名两个包（收窄，已声明）；库里的行不动。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts` 的 `keyedEntryBodies`（风险 hunk：剩余 body 的按值比较只决定保留，不决定包）；同文件 `keyedEntryOf`；`packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.test.ts` 末尾的 `[#32680]` describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata exec vitest run src/loaders/database-loader.test.ts -t 32680`，预期 54 个用例全绿（本 PR 新增 53 个，加改写的 #32458 用例 1 个）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。#32681（包外绑对象的 action 行该归哪个键）另需你拍板，见下方 Acceptance notes。

## What changes

`MetadataManager.loadMany`, for an unbundled type stored per `(package, name)` (`PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES`) on a loader that holds items per package (`loadManySlots`: `DatabaseLoader`, the artifact door's `MemoryLoader`), now hands on each keyed entry's own body, stamped (`_packageId`) with the package the loader holds that entry for when the body carries the entry's key as its `name` (`keyedEntryBodies`). It no longer pairs `loader.loadMany`'s bodies to the keyed entries by their `JSON.stringify` (the former `withLoaderEntryPackages`). Bodies the keyed read cannot name (a row whose `name` column is empty) are still handed on after them, unstamped: they are `loadMany`'s bodies less one per keyed entry whose body is the same value (key order aside), so the comparison decides only what is kept, never a package, and it runs only when `loadMany` answers more bodies than the keyed read.

`MetadataManager.loadManyKeyed` entries carry `packageId` where the loader's entry carries one (`keyedEntryOf`), for the slotted path and the bundled one (`email_template`).

Every moved answer, FROM to TO (the changeset carries the same list):

| Shape (host wiring a `DatabaseLoader`) | Read | FROM | TO |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Name two packages hold, beside another row whose body says the name (F2) | `MetadataManager.loadMany` | one body, unstamped | both holders stamped with their own row's package, the other row's body unstamped |
| same | boot pass registry | the one body in the bare slot | each package's slot, the other row's body in the bare slot |
| same | bare read after the pass | that body | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both packages (for `action` also `platform`, see notes); the same as without the pass |
| Name one package holds, beside another row whose body says the name | `loadMany` / boot pass | unstamped, filed in the bare slot | stamped, filed in the holder's slot |
| same | read naming a package that holds no row, after the pass | the holder's body | nothing, as without the pass |
| Loader whose two reads serialise a body differently (F3) | `loadMany` | both holders unstamped | both stamped |
| Any type stored per `(package, name)` | `MetadataManager.loadManyKeyed` | `{ name, data }` | `{ name, data, packageId }` where the loader holds it for a package |

Not changed: a name one package holds with no other row's body saying it (CONTROL pins), a name no package holds, and a loader without `loadManySlots`. The number of entries both plural reads hand on is unchanged for every shape but F2, where the other row's body is now kept beside both holders.

## Tests

New top-level describe `[#32680]` in `packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.test.ts` (53 cases): F2 per boot-pass type with the other row stored first and last (bare read 409 naming both after the pass; reads naming ALPHA, BETA, GAMMA equal the cold read); F3 with a key-reordering loader, plus a row whose name column is empty kept once; F4 per slotted type and `email_template`; one holder beside another row's body (every read equals the cold read); CONTROL one holder per type. The #32458 pin "two holders of a name and another row's body that says the same name" moves FROM `[[null, ALPHA]]` TO `[[ALPHA, ALPHA], [BETA, BETA], [null, ALPHA]]`, its title rewritten to say so.

BEFORE, on main `d4fbb4db` with the same fixtures: 43 of the 53 new cases red, the 10 CONTROLs green. The F2 bare read after the pass answered `com.alpha.app` with registry keys `['helper']` for every type.

Downstream readers (`MetadataManager.loadMany` / `loadManyKeyed` callers), consumer direction: objectql `action-governance`, `metadata-sync-flow-two-holders`, `plugin-governance-scoped-metadata`, `webhook-stored-row-boot-hydration` (59 passed); runtime `action-activation-unpackaged`, `actions-addressed-route`, `mcp-package-object-discovery`, `action-governance-scope-divergence` (218 passed).

Ablations (each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation landed on disk and restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty; the suite reads `src/` by relative import, so no build leg):

1. the keyed read swapped back for `loader.loadMany` (no stamp at all): 42 red (the CONTROLs among them, since this drops every stamp), the 12 F4 cases green;
2. `keyedEntryOf` without `packageId`: the 12 F4 cases red, nothing else;
3. the remainder compared by `JSON.stringify` instead of by value: the F3 case red (the empty-name row handed on twice);
4. the remainder dropped: F3 and the two #32458 pins that keep an empty-name row red.

## Acceptance notes

- **#32681 is not in this PR.** It is returned to the PM for a decision: which key a package-less action row bound to an object takes beside two packages that bind the name to different objects. Re-measured on this branch (the shape does not move here): ALPHA `approve` on `account`, BETA's on `contact`, a package-less one on `account`; the cold read naming ALPHA answers ALPHA's row, after the boot pass it answers the package-less row. The mirror shape moves too: one holder ALPHA on `account` and a package-less row on `contact` hand on one row (the package-less one, folded into ALPHA by the loader's per-name D4 rule), so after the pass a read naming ALPHA answers the `contact` row where the cold read answers ALPHA's `account` row. ADR-0150 D4's action key `(package, objectName, name)` and its R15 row ("two holders → the ambiguous set") read the shape two ways, so it is not settled here.
- For `action`, the F2 bare refusal after the pass also names `platform`: the other row (stored under its own key) is registered under its body's name in the bare slot, and an action name's package-less registry slot that no loader stores under that name counts as the platform's (#32560). The boot pass registering a stored row under its body's `name` rather than its row key is unchanged here.
- No change in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/**` and none in `packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.ts` (open PR #33193 edits it).
- Local gates were narrowed to the package's tests, typecheck, the new pins and the ablations; the derived gate families run in CI.
